pairs.question: Quare ergo petis amorem, si apud Deum et homines inde reprobus inveniris atque blasphemus?
pairs.answer: Certe non ob aliud, nisi ut cum Deo mundi valeas amittere famam.
pairs.derivation: Author poses a real interrogative (Quare ... petis?) and answers it himself in the immediately following sentence (Certe non ob aliud, nisi ...). Section marker [27] stripped from the start of the paragraph; question and answer are contiguous and complete. Other interrogatives in the work (e.g. [4], [10], [48], [91], [109], [115]) are rhetorical with no separate answering sentence and were dropped.
